name: Vasaka
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; the leaf juice or decoction is taken with honey, or as a syrup.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: Its alkaloid vasicine led to the medicine bromhexine.

cautions.note: Avoid in pregnancy; it has traditionally been used to bring on contractions.
Not enough is known; avoid while breastfeeding.

evidence.summary: Laboratory and animal studies; small human studies of its alkaloids. The herb itself is little studied in people.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
